reading.title: The Toy Box
reading.purpose: Hear words that tell how things are different.
paras: Look at the toy box. Now it is empty. We put in the blocks, and now it is full.
One big block is heavy. I need two hands to lift it. A tall tower is fun to build. Then we run fast to tell Dad!

qs.q: The toy box is empty. What does empty mean?
choices: It holds as much as it can.
qs.why: Empty means there is nothing inside, so the box has no blocks yet.

qs.q: How does the toy box get full?
qs.why: The reading says we put in the blocks, and now it is full.
The reading says we run fast to tell Dad.

reading.retellFrame: The toy box was empty, and then it was ___.
